purpose: This table is a small reference dataset of airline carriers, mapping each two-letter IATA carrier code to its full legal airline name, intended to feed joins against flight or ticketing fact tables that record only the carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column to resolve human-readable airline names; since the table is a reference dimension with 16 rows and no duplicates, no deduplication or null filtering is required before joining.
limitations: The profile shows only 16 rows with zero nulls and zero duplicates, so no cleanup decisions around missing or conflicting data were needed; however, the dataset's coverage of carriers is limited to what was captured at ingestion time (_airbyte_extracted_at: 2026-09-02T23:26:17) and may not reflect carriers added or renamed afterward.
